mapper.select: SELECT T.CUSTOMER_ID, T.ORD_CNT, (SELECT C.CUSTOMER_NAME FROM CUSTOMER C WHERE C.CUSTOMER_ID = T.CUSTOMER_ID) AS custNm FROM ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS ORD_CNT, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS SUM_AMT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDERED_AT >= #{fromDt} GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) T WHERE T.SUM_AMT > #{minAmt} ORDER BY T.ORD_CNT DESC
SELECT X.ORDER_ID AS ordNo, X.ORDERED_AT AS ordDt FROM (SELECT * FROM ORDERS WHERE STATUS = '90') X
